why_good: A full-stack China A-share data toolkit — quotes, research, fund flows, filings, sentiment, with fallback sources. 8k stars.
value: Market-data plumbing monetizes as an API/subscription for quant-retail and small funds — a niche where reliability is worth paying for.

zh.claim: simonlin1212/a-stock-data —— A股全栈数据工具包:10 层架构、43 端点、15 数据源,行情/研报/资金面/筹码/公告/打板/ETF期权/舆情全覆盖 + 备用源降级。
zh.why_good: 一个 A 股全栈数据工具包——行情、研报、资金流、公告、舆情,还带备用源降级。8k★。
zh.value: 行情数据管道靠 API/订阅变现,卖给量化散户和小基金——一个可靠性值钱的细分。
zh.risk: 只有 2 位贡献者 = 单点风险;中国金融数据再分发可能撞上牌照/合规墙。
zh.hook: 自己攒 A 股 AI 助手的散户量化玩家，反复撞上失效数据接口——akshare 挂了、东财换了请求头——工作流一断，几天内就来报修。
zh.does: 一个自包含的 Claude Code/Codex Skill：15 个数据源、44 个 A 股端点——行情、研报、资金面、筹码、公告、打板、ETF 期权、舆情——主源被封自动降级到备用源。不到三个月 8k star、1.5k fork。
zh.gap: 痛点击中但解得不完美：接口每周都在死（issue #18）、只有 2 个维护者，而且只有会用 Claude Code 的极客能用——普通股民完全碰不到。
zh.counter: 转发 A 股数据是合规雷区：东财/同花顺随时掐源，一纸函件就归零。免费侧有 akshare、付费侧有 iFind/Wind 两头夹击，散户付费意愿又出了名的低。
zh.differentiator: 切入口是可靠性 + 包装而不是加接口：做一个有测试、有维护的数据层，或在其上做散户问答产品（「今天连板梯队怎么样？」）。合规风险是 watch 而非 build 的原因。工量 2m。
zh.consumer_angle: 散户不装 Claude Code 也能用：直接提问的 A 股数据问答助手。

hook: Retail quant tinkerers building A-share AI assistants keep hitting dead data endpoints — akshare breaks, 东财 rotates headers — and they file outage reports within days because their whole workflow stops.
pick_reason: The project appears to be a collection of data sources without a clear monetizable product.

does: A self-contained Claude Code/Codex skill bundling 44 A-share endpoints across 15 sources — quotes, research reports, fund flows, 筹码, filings, 打板, ETF options, sentiment — with fallback sources when a primary gets blocked. 8k stars and 1.5k forks in under 3 months.
gap: Hits a real pain but imperfectly: endpoints die weekly (issue #18), there are only 2 maintainers, and only geeks running Claude Code can use it — ordinary retail investors can't touch any of it.
counter: Redistributing CN market data is a licensing minefield: 东财/同花顺 can kill sources at will and one compliance letter ends it. akshare (free) and iFind/Wind (paid) bracket it from both sides, and retail willingness to pay is notoriously low.
differentiator: The wedge is reliability + packaging, not more endpoints: a maintained, tested data layer — or a consumer 问答 product ('今天连板梯队怎么样？') on top. Compliance risk is why this is watch, not build. Workload: 2m.
consumer_angle: 散户不装 Claude Code 也能用：直接提问的 A 股数据问答助手。
